symptom: `mxcli check` reports MDL063 "'$Variable_1' is created twice … CE0111" for two calls to a microflow that returns nothing, and describe heads the flow with "duplicate output variable … model is invalid". Evora's OIDC.webCallback, OIDC.SUB_HandleUserProvisioning and two Teamcenter microflows (0 errors under mx check) were refused
cause: #953 taught voidCodeActions that a void Java/JavaScript call's output name declares nothing, but only for code actions. Studio Pro stores calls to void microflows/nanoflows the same way (ResultVariableName + UseReturnVariable=true), and the resolver never looked at them
insight: A fix keyed on one action kind should be re-asked of every action kind with an output name. Measured on mxbuild 10.24.15 and 11.13.0: two void microflow calls of one name 0, void call then declare 0, two void nanoflow calls 0, reading a void microflow call's output CE0109 (so MDL093 now covers it), two String microflow calls CE0111 (control). Resolution goes script first, then GetRawUnitByName+ParseMicroflowBSON; an unresolvable callee still counts under check's strict policy
